change.description: Prevent Product Release input freezing from timing out on large public media snapshots, add fail-closed no-input recovery, and allow a new manual run to take over only an unfrozen failed manual run.
change.release_unit_description: static frontend and full-feature Docker image

planned.reasoning: This is a backward-compatible release orchestration fix. It changes only bounded release workers, workflow recovery, and source-bound identity validation; public endpoints, application data, and persistent formats remain unchanged.

current.reasoning: Product Release now passes an explicit concurrency of 8 to the public media freezer, validates the bound in the release input layer, and extends only the signed production release timeout to 360 minutes; it also supports a no-input recovery dispatch that resolves one registered merged identity, validates the original source policy tree, and can rebind only an unfrozen failed manual run. Content deployment remains at one worker.
